failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 2017年上半年首单用户
first_half_2017_users AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date
    FROM 
        orders o
    WHERE 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01' AND 
        o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id
),
-- 2017年下半年订单（排除上半年首单用户中已取消/不可用的订单）
second_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month
    FROM 
        orders o
    WHERE 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' AND 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp <= '2017-12-31' AND 
        o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
-- 判断用户是否在2017年下半年有订单
retained_users AS (
    SELECT 
        f.customer_id,
        f.first_order_date,
        sh.order_month,
        TRUE AS returned
    FROM 
        first_half_2017_users f
    JOIN 
        second_half_2017_orders sh ON f.customer_id = sh.customer_id
),
-- 按月统计留存率
monthly_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_order_date) AS cohort_month,
        sh.order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ru.returned IS TRUE THEN ru.customer_id END) AS returned_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS total_users
    FROM 
        first_half_2017_users f
    LEFT JOIN 
        second_half_2017_orders sh ON f.customer_id = sh.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        retained_users ru ON f.customer_id = ru.customer_id AND DATE_TRUNC('month', sh.order_purchase_timestamp) = ru.order_month
    GROUP BY 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_order_date),
        sh.order_month
)
-- 计算留存率
SELECT 
    cohort_month AS 首单月份,
    order_month AS 留存月份,
    ROUND(100.0 * returned_users / NULLIF(total_users, 0), 2) AS 留存率
FROM 
    monthly_retention
ORDER BY 
    cohort_month,
    order_month
LIMIT 100;

failures.question: 运费占 GMV 的比例是多少？按宏观区域拆解。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT 
    r.macro_region,
    SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS freight_ratio
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN 
    regions r ON s.seller_state = r.region_code
WHERE 
    o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 
    r.macro_region
ORDER BY 
    freight_ratio DESC
LIMIT 100;

failures.question: 各类工单的 SLA 达成率是多少？（解决时间不超过类目 SLA 小时数）
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT 
    tc.category_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
        AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0 <= tc.sla_hours
    ) / COUNT(*), 2) AS sla_rate
FROM 
    support_tickets st
JOIN 
    ticket_categories tc ON st.category_id = tc.category_id
GROUP BY 
    tc.category_name
LIMIT 1000;

failures.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
m17 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM 
    order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
m18 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM 
    order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(m17.month, m18.month) AS month,
  COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2017,
  COALESCE(m18.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2018,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(m18.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0)) / COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0), 2)
  END AS yoy_growth
FROM 
  m17
FULL OUTER JOIN m18 ON m17.month = m18.month
ORDER BY 
  month
LIMIT 12;
